short_scenes.say: Adding two sine waves? Trigonometry nightmare!
short_scenes.narration: Volt has to add two sine waves with different phases. Pages of trigonometry ahead.
Turn each wave into an arrow, a phasor. Place them tip to tail. The result: five point six six at forty five degrees.
